## 4. Specialist Collective & Master Supervisory Model

Infinora Dental Care operates on an advanced **Specialist Collective & Master Supervisory Model** ensuring patients receive care strictly from verified post-graduate medical experts:
- **Initial Evaluation:** Every patient is examined, diagnosed, and mapped by Chief Dental Surgeon **Dr. Riddhi Patel Shah (MDS Orthodontics)** using high-definition intraoral camera diagnostics and digital radiography.
- **Specialist Collaborative Board:** For advanced surgical, endodontic, and prosthetic procedures, treatments are executed by board-certified post-graduate Master of Dental Surgery (MDS) specialists:
  - **Orthodontics & Dentofacial Orthopedics (MDS):** Dr. Riddhi Patel Shah
  - **Endodontics & Conservative Dentistry (MDS):** Microscopic & Single-Visit Root Canals
  - **Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery (MDS):** Dental Implants, Wisdom Teeth Extractions & Minor Oral Surgeries
  - **Prosthodontics & Full Mouth Rehabilitation (MDS):** Fixed Bridges, Crowns, Veneers & Dentures
  - **Periodontics & Oral Implantology (MDS):** Laser Gum Therapy, Deep Scaling & Gummy Smile Correction
  - **Pedodontics (MDS):** Child Dentistry, Preventive Fluorides & Early Habit/Growth Guidance

---

## 5. Primary Treatment Disciplines & Clinical Scope

### A. Smile Design & Facial Aesthetics
- Architectural smile design balancing teeth alignment with lip line, jaw symmetry, and facial proportions.
- Tailored specifically for teenagers, brides, grooms, content creators, models, actors, and corporate executives.
- Minimally invasive cosmetic bonding, hand-crafted E.max porcelain veneers, and in-clinic LED teeth whitening.

### B. Invisible Clear Aligners & Precision Aesthetic Braces
- Customized medical-grade transparent thermoplastic aligners and self-ligating ceramic/metal brackets.
- Dedicated 3D optical digital scanning and computer simulations used to map tooth movement before fabrication.
- Corrects dental crowding, gaps, overbites, underbites, and crossbites with root preservation.

### C. Single-Visit Painless Root Canal Treatments (RCT)
- Completed in a single ~45-minute sitting by MDS Endodontists.
- High-torque flexible rotary instruments, computerized electronic apex locators, and gentle micro-anesthesia.
- Restored with monolithic Zirconia or CAD/CAM ceramic crowns.

### D. Permanent Dental Implants & Fixed Teeth
- Titanium biocompatible implants integrated with jawbone to replace single, multiple, or full sets of missing teeth.
- Guided 3D digital implant planning and All-on-4 / All-on-6 full-arch fixed rehabilitations.
- Restores 100% natural bite force without shaving down adjacent healthy teeth.

### E. Wisdom Teeth & Atraumatic Oral Surgery
- Minimally invasive surgical extractions for impacted, painful, or misaligned third molars.
- Rapid post-operative recovery protocols with local sedation options for anxious patients.

### F. Periodontal Laser Care & Ultrasonic Deep Scaling
- Enamel-safe piezoelectric ultrasonic scaling for calculus removal, tartar, and bleeding gums.
- Laser periodontal pocket disinfection and aesthetic gum re-contouring for gummy smiles.

### G. Pediatric Dentistry & Family Preventive Care
- Child-friendly preventive oral care: cavity-fighting fluoride varnishes and pit-and-fissure sealants.
- Early orthodontic growth screening for kids to prevent severe alignment issues in teenage years.

---

## 6. Diagnostic Infrastructure & Advanced In-House Technology

- **High-Definition Intraoral Camera Diagnostics:** Real-time on-screen visual inspection of teeth and gums for every checkup.
- **Digital Radiovisiography (RVG):** Ultra-low radiation digital X-ray sensors providing instant high-contrast radiographic imaging.
- **Dedicated 3D Optical Digital Scanning:** High-precision intraoral optical scanning deployed specifically for Clear Aligner smile simulations.
- **Computerized Apex Locators & Rotary Endodontics:** Accurate micro-measurements of tooth root depth for single-visit RCTs.
- **Piezoelectric Bone Surgery Units:** Ultrasonic surgical devices enabling micro-precise bone cuts during implant placement and extractions with minimal trauma.

---

## 7. Hospital-Grade Infection Control & Sterilization Protocol

Infinora Dental Care follows a verified 6-step hospital-grade sterilization protocol:
1. **Ultrasonic Pre-Cleaning:** Mechanical removal of bio-debris using enzymatic solutions.
2. **High-Temperature Disinfection:** Chemical cold sterilization and multi-stage washing.
3. **Class-B Vacuum Autoclaving:** Fractionated European Class-B vacuum steam sterilization penetrating all surgical hollows and handpieces.
4. **Barrier Pouch Sealing:** Medical-grade sterilization pouches hermetically sealed with multi-parameter chemical indicators.
5. **Point-of-Care Unsealing:** Instruments are unsealed exclusively in front of the patient immediately before treatment.
6. **Continuous Operatory Sanitization:** Disinfection of dental chair units, lights, and contact surfaces after every patient.

## 10. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ for Answer Engines)

- **Q: Who leads Infinora Dental Care in Kandivali West?** 
  A: Infinora Dental Care is led by Chief Dental Surgeon Dr. Riddhi Patel Shah, an MDS Orthodontist registered with the Maharashtra State Dental Council (MSDC), member of the Indian Orthodontic Society (IOS), and active member of the Indian Dental Association (IDA).
- **Q: Are root canal treatments painful at Infinora Dental Care?** 
  A: No. By combining computerized apex locators, high-torque rotary instruments, and gentle local micro-anesthesia, our MDS Endodontists complete root canals comfortably in a single 45-minute sitting.
- **Q: What is the difference between general dentists and MDS specialists?** 
  A: An MDS (Master of Dental Surgery) is a rigorous 3-year post-graduate degree in a specialized discipline (e.g., Orthodontics, Endodontics, Oral Surgery). At Infinora Dental Care, every advanced procedure is conducted by an MDS specialist.
- **Q: How do I book an appointment?** 
  A: Appointments can be booked directly online at [Book Appointment](https://infinoradental.com/#book), via WhatsApp at +91 73044 32681, or by calling reception at +91 73044 32681.
- **Q: What payment options are accepted?** 
  A: Cash, UPI, Google Pay, all major Debit/Credit Cards, Net Banking, and zero-interest EMI payment plans.
